# Remix Icon assets

Project UI icon source: https://remixicon.com/ (user-selected).

These original SVGs were retrieved on 2026-09-07 from the official repository:

- https://github.com/Remix-Design/RemixIcon/blob/master/icons/System/upload-2-line.svg
- https://github.com/Remix-Design/RemixIcon/blob/master/icons/Document/folder-image-line.svg

License: bundled `LICENSE`, Remix Icon License v1.0.
Keep assets local so the prototype does not require the icon website at runtime.

2026-09-28: Added `artboard-line.svg` for the creative canvas mode from
https://github.com/Remix-Design/RemixIcon/blob/master/icons/Design/artboard-line.svg.
The bundled Remix Icon license applies.

2026-09-08: Added official icons/Arrows/arrow-down-line.svg, icons/Arrows/arrow-up-line.svg, icons/System/delete-bin-line.svg from the same Remix-Design/RemixIcon repository.

2026-09-28: Added Media/image-line.svg, Media/video-line.svg, Design/scissors-cut-line.svg and Design/layout-grid-line.svg from the same official repository for the four-item creative node menu.

- `draggable.svg`: Remix Icon Editor/draggable, six-dot row/column move handle. Source: https://github.com/Remix-Design/RemixIcon/blob/master/icons/Editor/draggable.svg
settings-3-line.svg: Remix Icon 4.6.0, settings gear; bundled from the official remixicon npm package.

check-line.svg, error-warning-line.svg, restart-line.svg, play-line.svg: Remix Icon 4.6.0; generation preview status and actions.
